Independently sampled complex photographic outdoor scene for a realistic-background keyword realization test, using the attached adult woman as appearance and identity reference. Scene selection and staging are agent-authored, not requester definitions.

A natural photographic travel portrait of one adult woman matching the supplied reference face, dark eyes, softly parted lips, and long wavy dark hair, at an alpine botanical terrace above a reservoir in late spring. She wears a muted olive field jacket, cream knit top, dark walking trousers and brown hiking boots. She stands on the broad dry upper landing, both boots planted apart on the same level, torso upright; her nearer forearm reaches gently forward with a relaxed elbow, and her open palm rests flat on the waist-high stone parapet immediately beside her hip. Her other hand hangs visibly by her thigh. Her face turns toward the camera with a quiet, attentive expression. Show her complete body within the surrounding place. Rough chipped parapet stones fill one lower foreground edge; tiny rooted plants occupy some mortar joints. A flight of stone steps descends away behind her into the middle distance, its lower shaded treads dark with irregular residual rainwater while the exposed upper landing has dried. Uneven remnants of old snow survive beneath shadowed shrubs along the terrace edge. Beyond the gardens lies the blue-green reservoir, then a far mountain slope bearing narrow switchback paths that diminish convincingly with distance. Close stones retain distinct grain, middle shrubs have grouped leaves, and the distant mountain retains broad landforms with softer texture and lighter contrast. Cool open daylight from the cloudy alpine sky illuminates her face and the landscape consistently. The scene feels occupied and weathered through localized physical traces, coherent perspective and contact shadows, with enough environmental detail to read the actual place.
